anti_ai_mandate.core_directive: ELIMINATE AI SLOP AND TEMPLATE MONOTONY. NO purple gradients, NO centered generic hero boxes, NO fake 500-spot countdowns, NO $9.99 pricing. Make it feel like an authentic, human-designed, editorial magazine meets high-precision Swiss tactical terminal.
key_design_moves: Asymmetric grid layouts with generous breathing space
Tactical high-contrast editorial typography (Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit + JetBrains Mono + DM Sans)
Organic paper & warm obsidian surfaces with delicate 1px subtle strokes
Interactive live components (Real-time Market Ticker simulator, Interactive Atlas AI Chat Demo, Translated News Feed)
Authentic Founder Letter from Justin (Canada) explaining why Mentova went 100% FREE
Explicit language switcher (FR, EN, ES) with full localization dictionary
Roadmap section showing hidden/upcoming features (Community Forum, Human Mentors, VIP Tools)
Direct CTAs linking to app.mentova-academy.com without frictionless paywalls

founder_story.headline: Why I made Mentova 100% Free for everyone.
founder_story.quote: Crypto education was broken. Too many fake gurus charging $9.99/month for regurgitated Telegram signals and generic AI summaries. Mentova started as a paid experiment, but I realized knowledge should never be gatekept. Today, Mentova is completely free. No credit card, no VIP paywalls, no fake scarcity.
